$comment: CLI input example, in plan form (S13): each wall has `start`/`end` on the centerline (inches or feet-inches, sign allowed) instead of `length`; opening offsets and `center` are measured from `start`. W01 (12') and W02 (16') make a corner at (0,0): W02 is the longer one and would run through (16'-2 3/4" plate, above the BOM's 16' stock — splices are S15), so W01 declares `ends.start: "through"` and runs through: plate 146 3/4" (to the outer face of W02), layout origin 0; W02 butts: plate 189 1/4" (starts at the inner face of W01), origin −5.5 (layout mark 0 is the corner). W03 (interior bearing 2x4) butts as a tee in the middle of W02: plate 117 1/4". W04–W07 are loose walls, set apart on the plan (free ends): they come out the same as in the previous example. config.studLength = factory precuts (P7); headerHeight 82.5 = factory default header height (P2), overridden per opening when the project gives another (W06). Header (S9.2): `building` carries the snow load and the house width; W05 and W06 (exterior bearing, floorsSupported 0 = roof only) get the header from IRC table R602.7(1) — 2-2x6 with 2 jacks; W07 carries the project header (`header` 2-2x10) on both openings, which overrides the table. W04 (interior non-bearing) has a door with the flat member of R602.7.4 (source `R602.7.4`, no cripples above). W07 = window and door 4.5" apart (jack + shared king + jack), like fixture wall-144-window-door (with the table's 2 jacks the ROs would need 7.5"); the door's bottom plate comes out in one piece and the SVG marks the field cut. Walls up to 16' — none is split (S15: a wall over 240" would come out as W-P1, W-P2…). S12: `building.windSpeed` 120 mph / exposure B → kings from Table R602.7.5 (all openings ≤ 4' → 1 king); `doubleSillOver` 6' → no window in the example gets a double sill. S12.5: project catalog — `openingTypes` (J36 = 35 1/2" x 47 1/4" window, RO 36x48 by the default +1/2" x +3/4" allowance, P32; P30 = 30x80 wood door, RO 32 x 82 1/2" by the +2" x +2 1/2" allowance, P33) and `headerSchedule` (HDR1 = 2-2x10, 1 jack, 1 king). W04 and W05 describe the opening by `tag` + `center`; W07 uses `headerMark` on both openings. 125 pieces (it was 123 with W01 and W02 loose: each plate that grew gained a stud). S14: California corner in W01 (flat stud at x=1.5, because it runs through) and ladder blocking in W02 in the tee zone of W03 (3 2x6 blocks; double top cut in two pieces); W02's double top steps back 5.5 at the corner and W01's extends 5.5; W03's extends 5.5 over W02 — 130 pieces. S16: `northAngle` at the root (degrees, from the plan's +y, clockwise) puts the north arrow in `plan.svg`; panels come out as `{level}-{wallId}-P{n}` (`1-W01-P1`). S17: `date` and `revision` at the root go into the title block of the sheets (`panels/<id>.svg`), along with `name`.
name: sample-house
